title: Dirtyfrag: Universal Linux LPE
summary: Dirtyfrag is a universal Linux local privilege escalation vulnerability affecting kernel versions 5.7+, disclosed via the oss-security mailing list with significant community attention (628 points, 258 comments).
problem_solved: Exploits a Linux kernel memory management vulnerability to escalate from unprivileged user to root privileges locally.
why_valuable: Provides a proof-of-concept for a kernel-level privilege escalation that affects millions of Linux systems, critical for security hardening and patching prioritization.
